en: Sepia-toned vintage image showing a historic European town square with a large ornamental fountain in the foreground. The fountain has a circular basin with a metal railing, several curved water spouts, and multiple sculpted figures around a central column topped by a statue of a man holding an object aloft. Behind the fountain stands a large building with steeply pitched tiled roofs, dormer windows, a small turret with half-timbered detailing, and an arcaded balcony supported by columns. The overall style is late medieval / Renaissance central European. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.
